body:
marta_cs: Heads-up — NovaQ renewal lands next week. They want to migrate 50 dev seats to prod, net +20 seats, and are asking for a one-time credit for the downtime last month. Need pricing signoff + PO path. cc @jake_sales @oliver_legal @kevin_billing
jake_sales: got it. Do we have the exact dates for the migration window and the downtime they reference? I want to quantify the credit request before committing anything.
marta_cs: migration target week of 2026-04-06. Downtime incident was 2026-02-14 — they're asking for a credit equal to 25% of one month for the 30 affected seats.
kevin_billing: rough calc — 30 seats * $375/mo = $11,250, 25% => $2,812.50 credit. We can do a one-time credit line item on the renewal invoice. Need PO and vendor code to attach it.
jake_sales: thanks. If we add +20 net seats to the 12mo renewal, pricing model gives us room to absorb some credit. What if we offer a 10% credit on the new seats for first month instead of the flat $2.8k? Might be cleaner for billing.
marta_cs: client prefers a single credit line on the renewal invoice vs. ongoing discount. They asked for credit not discount.
oliver_legal: quick legal check — any changes to the T&Cs from the migration or credit? If we add an amendment we should include language that this credit is goodwill and not admission of liability. Also confirm NovaQ is EU-registered and provide VAT number so we handle tax on the credit correctly.
kevin_billing: noted. We also need to confirm whether credit is taxable in their jurisdiction. Ask NovaQ for VAT ID + billing contact.
emma_success: I'll prep the onboarding checklist for seat migration and schedule the runbook review. If billing holds the credit, we need to confirm account reassign steps so seats map cleanly to prod.
jake_sales: I'll ask NovaQ for a PO and VAT ID now. My outreach: "Can you send PO referencing PO-2143 and your VAT number? Also confirm acceptance of the renewal amendment we’ll send via DocuSign."
docuSign-bot: Envelope created: EnvelopeId 0a9f-2143-novaq — "NovaQ Renewal Amendment (Seat Migration + Credit)" sent to nova.billing@novaq.eu. Status: Sent.
marta_cs: oliver, can you draft the 1-paragraph amendment? Needs to: 1) list net seat change (+20), 2) state one-time credit amount (or placeholder if Jake negotiates), 3) state credit is goodwill/no admission.
oliver_legal: drafting now. Proposed language snippet: "As full and final commercial accommodation for the February 14, 2026 service disruption, Provider will issue a one-time credit to Customer in the amount of EUR {{CREDIT_AMOUNT}}. Such credit shall not constitute an admission of liability." Pls confirm currency once VAT ID is in.
jake_sales: customer replied — they will provide VAT ID and PO-2143 by EOD. They prefer EUR invoice.
kevin_billing: convert $2,812.50 -> EUR at today's rate ~ €2,600 (ballpark). I'll wait for finalized credit amount but we can provision a credit memo. Also we need their vendor code for procurement mapping.
marta_cs: OK — plan: Oliver finalizes amend with EUR amount placeholder. Jake to attach PO and VAT. Kevin to create credit memo once amount finalized. Emma to schedule migration runbook. I’ll keep customer updates.
jake_sales: PO + VAT received: PO-2143, VAT DE123456789. They confirm EUR invoice. Forwarding to oliver/legal.
oliver_legal: updated amendment attached in thread (see snippet). Language finalized: credit €2,600 as full and final. Sending to DocuSign now.
docuSign-bot: Envelope updated: EnvelopeId 0a9f-2143-novaq — Signer: nova.billing@novaq.eu. Status: Completed (signed) at 2026-03-28T14:12:03Z.
kevin_billing: received signed amendment. Creating credit memo CM-210111-NUQ for €2,600 against renewal invoice. Will generate invoice with credit line and updated seat qty.
emma_success: migration scheduled 2026-04-07 09:00 CET. I'll do a dry-run with NovaQ on 04-03. Onboarding checklist assigned to @emma_success and @marta_cs.
marta_cs: beautiful — locking terms: 12-month renewal, +20 net seats, one-time credit €2,600, PO-2143 attached, invoice in EUR, amendment signed. Closing on our side once Kevin sends invoice.
jake_sales: I'll follow up post-invoice to confirm payment ETA and hand over to accounts receivable if needed.
kevin_billing: invoice issued: INV-210111-NUQ, shows credit CM-210111-NUQ €2,600, net due in 30 days. Sending to nova.billing@novaq.eu and accounting@novacorp.eu.
marta_cs: thanks team. I'll post a recap to the customer and flag migration playbook. If anything blocks, re-open thread. :thumbsup:
